blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/HairDeck
blocks.zh: 游戏和相声中花纹化人物的发型由发卡来构建:艺术家-被放置的丝带,其几何是可见发型,由春骨作动画. 现有的以影像为基础的方法产生出现实的发型或单一的有丝网状的发型,而CHARM作为分型发卡的唯一生成者,会自发地解码出发型,作为长序的控制点. 观察到一卡通发型是一组无序由艺术家定义的原始人,我们提出"海尔德克"(HairDeck),将它产生为一卡通:每张卡是单一的代币,而一卡通扩散变压器则将所有卡通都一起取出. HairDeck从一幅相片中生成出卡和驱动出卡的弹簧骨链,从而产生出一个向现成使用下游格式输出的可想象资产. 在CHARM自己的测试设定上,它将Chamfer距离降低了44%,卡向误差在运行快33倍时降低了一半以上,从单个图像来看,它的表现超过了CHARM,图像到到到3D的管道和线程方法. 项目网页:https://hyz cluster.github.io/HairDeck

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
3D generators now produce convincing shapes from a single image [ 83 , 72 , 71 , 77 ] , but not the structure that artists build assets from.
The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is a clear example.
It is made of hair cards : a few dozen to over a hundred ribbons, each placed by an artist, whose geometry is the visible hair.
Unlike the alpha-textured hair cards of realistic hair, flat strips whose texture stands in for many strands [ 20 , 88 , 60 ] , these cards have a rhombic or triangular cross-section whose width and thickness vary along the card.
Such hair is commonly animated with spring bones : short chains of bones hung from the head whose tips are simulated every frame, so that the hair sways and settles.
Similar simulations ship as Dynamic Bone in Unity [ 18 ] , PhysBones in VRChat [ 61 ] , Kawaii Physics in Unreal Engine [ 36 ] and a node in Godot [ 10 ] .
Artists place every card and rig every chain by hand.
blocks.zh:
3D发电机现在从单一的图像[83,72,71,77]中产生令人信服的形状,但并不是艺术家从中积累资产的结构.

它由发卡所制: 有几十到一百多条丝带, 每一个由艺术家放置,

blocks.en:
Existing methods do not produce this asset.
Hair generators output realistic strands [ 49 , 13 , 42 ] , including recent ones that accept stylized images [ 28 , 31 , 44 , 65 ] , and card extraction turns such strands into alpha-textured cards for realistic hair [ 88 , 60 ] .
Image-to-3D generators [ 71 , 77 ] output a single fused mesh with no cards to animate.
CHARM [ 15 ] is the only generator of stylized hair cards and introduced the benchmark for them.
It generates the control points of a hairstyle one at a time, as a sequence of hundreds to thousands of discretized tokens.
blocks.zh:
现有方法不产生这种资产。
发相机输出出现实的片段[49,13,42],包括最近接受分型图像的片段[28,31,44,65],并取出出卡片将这种片段变成现实发相的α-文本片段[88,60].
图像到3D的发电机[71,77]输出出一个没有卡片的单丝网来动画.
CHARM [15]是斯氏发卡的唯一发电机,并为它们引入了基准.
它一次生成发型一的控制点,作为上百到上千个盘状符的序列.

blocks.en:
We observe that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, and we generate it as one.
Like CHARM, we describe each card by its control points (position, width and thickness), and we add its cross-section type and its root normal, the width direction at the root, so each card keeps the cross-section and the orientation the artist gave it.
What we change is the unit of generation, with two designs.
First, each card becomes one continuous token: a card VAE encodes its variable-length control points into a latent, and the token holds this latent with the card’s root position, root normal and cross-section type, so a hairstyle has one token per card, about 70 on average.
Second, all tokens of a hairstyle are generated together: a set diffusion transformer without positional embedding denoises them with flow matching [ 25 , 27 ] , and an existence flag on each token decides how many cards appear.
Each design makes generation more accurate and faster.
Together they amount to a simple rule for assets made of artist-defined primitives: one token per primitive, and no order among them.
blocks.zh:
我们观察一种卡片发型是一组没有顺序的艺术家定义的原始人,我们把它生成一个.
和CHARM一样,我们按其控制点(位置,宽度和厚度)来描述每张卡片,我们加上了它的横截面类型和根的常态,根的宽度方向,所以每张卡片都保留了横截面和艺术家给出的方向.
我们所改变的是 一代的单位, 有两个设计。
首先,每张卡成为一副连续的标志:一张卡VAE将它的可变长度控制点编码成潜伏点,而该标志与卡的根位置,根常态和横截面类型保持了这一潜伏点,因此发型每张卡有一枚标志,平均约为70个.
第二,发型的所有符号都是一起生成的:一个没有位置嵌入的放出变压器将它们与流相匹配[25,27],每个符号上的存在旗帜决定出出多少个牌.
每次设计都使生成更准确更快.
它们合起来就相当于一个简单的规则, 由艺术家定义的原始人制成的资产: 每个原始人一个符号, 没有命令。

blocks.en:
A single image shows the hair relative to the head, so we predict the cards in a head frame anchored to the face, which improves where the hair sits without changing its shape.
Images also come in many drawing styles, so we widen the appearance of our training renders in two ways: synthetic style augmentation, which improves accuracy on stylized inputs, and renders restyled by an image-editing model [ 68 ] , which keep the card structure stable across styles.
blocks.zh:
一个单一的图像显示头发相对于头部,所以我们预测在头框中被固定在面部的牌会改善头发坐放的地方而不改变外形.
图像也呈现出许多绘画风格,所以我们从两个方面拓宽了我们训练的外观: 合成风格增强,提高了分层输入的精度,并让图像编辑模型[68]使卡片结构在风格上保持稳定.

blocks.en:
Cards alone do not move.
We generate the spring-bone chains with the same recipe: each chain becomes one token holding its path, joint count and stiffness, and a second set diffusion transformer generates all chains of a hairstyle together from its card tokens.
With a fixed geometric skinning, the cards and chains form an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats.
blocks.zh:
单是牌是不会移动的。
我们用同样的食谱来生成弹簧骨链:每条链子都变成一个握住其路径,联合计数和僵硬的标志;第二套扩散变压器则从它的卡片符子一起产生出所有发型的链子.
通过固定的几何外观,卡片和链条形成一个可想象的资产,出口到现成的下游格式.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • A card token for stylized hair: a representation that keeps the cross-section type and the root normal, and a card VAE that encodes the variable-length control points into one continuous latent and decodes the card by arc length. • A set formulation of hair-card generation: a set diffusion transformer without positional embedding generates all card tokens of a hairstyle together, and an existence flag on each token decides how many cards appear. • Single-image generation with a face-anchored head frame, synthetic style augmentation and restyled renders. • Spring-bone chains generated as a second set conditioned on the card tokens, which makes the output animatable.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献是: · 花序发卡符:一种能使横截面类型和根常态保持的表示,和将可变长度控制点编码成一个连续潜伏并用弧长来解码卡的卡VAE. 二. 支助 发卡生成的一组配方: 一个没有位置嵌入的发卡变压器集生成发型的所有发卡符,每个发卡符上都有一个存在旗来决定出多少发卡. • 单相相片生成,并有相机头框、合成式增强和再接再励。 · 泉骨链作为第二套设定条件生成于卡币上,这使得输出可被映射出.

blocks.zh: 花序发相的卡符号:一种能使横截面类型和根正常的表示,而将可变长的控制点编码成一个连续潜伏并用弧长来解码出卡的卡VAE.

blocks.zh: 春骨链作为第二套设定条件生成于相克符上,这使得输出具有可映射性.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on CHARM’s test set with its protocol and also measure the orientation of every card against the original artist meshes.
HairDeck lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster.
From a single image, it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand generators.
blocks.zh:
也衡量每张卡片的取向,
低发 发卡距离为44%,取卡出错超过一半,同时运行速度快33倍.
从单一的图像来看,它比CHARM、图像到3D的管道和链路发电机的性能要好。

blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Hair reconstruction methods can recover strands from multi-view images or videos [ 35 , 41 , 48 , 69 , 57 , 32 , 80 ] and from single images [ 70 , 86 , 87 , 50 ] .
Generative models synthesize strands from latent codes [ 90 , 13 ] , text [ 49 ] and images [ 42 ] .
Recent ones accept stylized or anime images [ 28 , 31 , 44 , 65 ] , but their output is still strands, the representation of realistic hair.
The stylized hair we generate uses cards instead.
blocks.zh:
发型重建方法可以从多视图图像或视频[35、41、48、69、57、32、80]和单一图像[70、86、87、50]中取出线条。
遗传模型从潜在代码[90,13],文本[49]和图像[42]中合成线条.
近代人接受有型或有型的图像[28,31,44,65],但他们的输出仍然是线条,代表现实的发型.
我们生成的分型发型使用卡片代替.

blocks.en:
Real-time engines render realistic hair with textured strips [ 20 ] , the alpha-textured hair cards whose texture stands in for many strands.
Zheng et al . [ 88 ] and Strands2Cards [ 60 ] convert strand grooms into such cards, HairLRM [ 44 ] applies the former to its generated strands, CGHair [ 33 ] reconstructs card-based hair from multi-view images, Lee et al . [ 22 ] inpaint strips from the sparse strands of a single portrait with a diffusion model on the scalp UV map, HairCS [ 30 ] turns cards back into strands, and production tools ship card generators for grooms [ 8 , 46 ] .
Stylized hair uses a different card, whose geometry is the visible hair.
CHARM [ 15 ] introduced the generation of such cards with a control-point representation, a dataset of anime hairstyles (the benchmark we use) and an autoregressive transformer that emits the control points of a hairstyle one at a time.
We add the cross-section type and the root normal to its description of a card and change the unit of generation.
blocks.zh:
实时引擎使有纹理条的发型现实化[20],即有纹理的发卡,其纹理代表了多条线.
郑等. [88]和Strands2Cards [60] 将线条新郎转换成这样的卡片, HairLRM [44] 将前者应用到其生成的线条上, CGHair [33] 从多视图图像重建了以卡片为基础的发型, Lee等. [22] 从头皮紫外线图上带有扩散模型的一幅相片的稀疏线上取出印花条; HairCS [30] 将卡片回转为线条; 生产工具 为新郎制造出出出出船牌 [8,46].
丝状发型使用不同的卡片,其几何是可见发型.
CHARM [15]引入了这种卡片的生成,带有控制点的表示,一个动ime发型的数据集(我们使用的基准)和一个自动回转变速器,一次发出发型一个的控制点.
我们在卡片的描述中加入交叉类型和根常态,并更改生成单位.

blocks.en:
Image-based methods for anime characters reconstruct stylized heads [ 5 ] or full characters [ 38 , 64 ] , and others separate the body, clothing and hair into components [ 14 , 16 , 40 ] .
In all of them the hair is a continuous surface, fused with the character or as a separate component, rather than a set of cards.
Earlier work modeled anime and cartoon hair from sketches, skeletons or parametric clumps [ 34 , 43 , 76 ] or as 2.5D layers [ 79 ] .
blocks.zh:
基于图像的动画人物方法重建了被分化的头 [5] 或完整的字符 [38,64],而其他方法则将身体,衣着和发型分开为组件 [14,16,40].
在它们中,发型是一个连续的表面,与字符相接,或作为一个单独的组件,而不是一套牌.
早期的作品从草图,骨架或参数化克通[34,43,76]或作为2.5D层[79]来模拟动能和卡通发.

blocks.en:
Native 3D generators encode shapes as latent sets [ 81 , 85 , 83 , 4 ] or structured latents [ 72 , 71 ] and output a single surface.
Assets built from discrete elements are mostly generated autoregressively: meshes as sequences of face or vertex tokens [ 45 , 6 , 66 , 84 , 12 ] , ordered along triangle strips and UV charts in Strips as Tokens [ 73 ] , and shapes as sequences of primitives [ 78 ] .
Other work generates the elements of an asset together.
3DTopia-XL [ 7 ] gives each primitive one token and denoises the tokens with a diffusion transformer without positional encoding.
StrokeFusion [ 89 ] encodes each sketch stroke with a VAE and diffuses the unordered set of stroke latents with presence flags.
DiffuScene [ 59 ] , SALAD [ 21 ] , MeshFlow [ 56 ] , BrepGen [ 74 ] and PartCrafter [ 24 ] jointly generate the objects of a scene, part latents, the triangles of a mesh, the faces of CAD models and the parts of objects.
We build on this set formulation and design it for hair cards: a card VAE turns each card into one token, the set is conditioned on a point cloud or a single image, and a second set of spring-bone chains is conditioned on the cards.
On the same tokens, set generation is both more accurate and faster than autoregressive generation.
blocks.zh:
原生三维发电机将形状编码为潜在装置[81、85、83、4]或结构化潜在装置[72、71],并输出出单一表面。
由离散元素所建立的资产大多是自相递减地生成的: meshes作为面相或顶相符的序列 [45, 6, 66, 84, 12], 沿着三角形条纹和紫外线图以Tokens [73] 为条纹排列,形状作为原始物的序列 [78].
其他工作共同产生资产的要素。
3DTopia-XL [7] 给每个原始的符号一个,并用不作位置编码的放行变压器来将符号去出.
中风相接 [89] 用 VAE 编码每张素描中风, 并用外观旗来扩散未排列的中风潜质 。
DiffuScene [59], SALAD [21], MeshFlow [56], BrepGen [74] and PartCrafter [24] 共同生成一个场景的物体,部分潜伏物,一个网格的三角形,CAD模型的面部和物体的部分.
我们以此套配并设计出发卡:一卡VAE将每张发卡转换为一活字牌,该套配以点云或一成相片为条件,第二套弹簧骨链以发卡为条件.
同样,设定生成既准确又快于自旋生成.

blocks.en:
Automatic rigging predicts a skeleton and skinning weights for a given mesh [ 75 , 52 , 26 , 11 , 51 , 55 ] .
UniRig [ 82 ] also predicts spring bones and their physical attributes on VRoid characters [ 39 ] , and DRiVE [ 54 ] generates skeletons that include hair and skirt bones for anime characters represented as 3D Gaussians.
Both rig an existing asset.
We generate the spring-bone chains together with the hair they drive, conditioned on the generated cards, and simulate them with the spring-bone update of the VRM specification [ 62 , 63 ] .
blocks.zh:
自动操纵预言给定网格的骨架和剥取重量[75,52,26,11,51,55].
UniRig [82] 还在VRoid字符上预测了春季骨骼及其物理属性[39],而DRIVE [54] 生成骨架,包括以3D高斯人为代表的有线人物的发型和花裙骨.
都装入了现有资产
我们产生弹簧骨链 和它们驱动的发型, 以生成的卡片为条件, 用弹簧骨更新 VRM 规格 [62, 63] 模拟它们.

blocks.en:
We propose HairDeck, which generates the cards of a hairstyle and the spring-bone chains to animate them ( Fig. 2 ).
Each card is encoded into one continuous token ( Sec. 3.1 ), and a set diffusion transformer (set DiT) generates all card tokens together, conditioned on a single image ( Sec. 3.3 ) or on a point cloud ( Sec. 3.2 ), the input of CHARM’s benchmark.
The card VAE decodes each token back into control points, from which we build the mesh.
A second set DiT, the chain DiT, generates the spring-bone chains conditioned on the card tokens, and a fixed geometric skinning attaches the cards to them ( Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
我们提出"发型"(hairDeck),它能产生发型和弹簧骨链的卡片来活化它们(图2).
每张卡被编码成一个连续的代号(Sec. 3.1),一个集散式变压器(set DiT)生成所有相片代号,以单一图像(Sec. 3.3)或点云(Sec. 3.2)为条件,是CHARM基准的输入.
卡片VAE将每个令牌解码回回控制点,我们从中构建网格.
第二套DiT,链式DiT,生成以卡符为条件的弹簧-骨链,固定的几何外观将卡片附在它们上(第3.4节).

blocks.en: 3.1 Hair cards as tokens
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 发牌作纪念

blocks.en:
Like CHARM [ 15 ] , we describe a hair card by a polyline of n n control points ( 𝐩 i , w i , h i ) (\mathbf{p}_{i},w_{i},h_{i}) , each with a position 𝐩 i ∈ ℝ 3 \mathbf{p}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{3} , a width w i w_{i} and a thickness h i h_{i} .
We add two attributes that this description leaves out: the cross-section type s s , rhombic or triangular, instead of one rhombic cross-section for all cards, and the root normal 𝐝 1 \mathbf{d}_{1} , the width direction of the card at its root, read from the artist mesh instead of being estimated from the first three control points.
To build a card mesh, we propagate 𝐝 1 \mathbf{d}_{1} along the polyline with a rotation-minimizing (Bishop) frame [ 1 ] , giving the width direction 𝐝 i \mathbf{d}_{i} at every control point, and sweep the cross-section along it.
blocks.zh:
和CHARM [15]一样,我们用由 n 控制点组成的多行来描述发卡(p i, w i, h i) (\mathbf{p}_{i},w_{i},h_{i}),每个发卡都有一个位置 p. i 相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相接相接相接相接相相相接相接相相相相接相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
我们添加了这一描述所忽略的两个属性: 横切类型 s s, rhombic 或 三相, 而非所有卡片的一个rhombic 横切, 和根正常 d 1\ mathbf{ d}_{1}, 从画家网格读取出卡片的宽度方向, 而不是从前三个控制点来估计 。
为了建立卡片网格,我们用旋转-最小化(Bishop)框[1]沿多线传播 d 1\ mathbf{d}_{1},给出每个控制点的宽度方向 di\mathb{d}_{i},并沿它扫取横切.

blocks.en:
Cards differ in their number of control points, while the generator needs a token of fixed size.
A card VAE encodes the control points of a card, relative to its root position 𝐩 1 \mathbf{p}_{1} , into a latent 𝐳 ∈ ℝ 32 \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{32} ( Fig. 3 , top).
Its encoder is a transformer over the control points, each tagged with its arc-length fraction u i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] u_{i}\in[0,1] , together with a learned summary token whose output gives the mean and log-variance of 𝐳 \mathbf{z} .
The decoder predicts the number of control points n n from 𝐳 \mathbf{z} with a classification head and evaluates the card at n n uniformly spaced arc-length fractions, embedded with low-frequency Fourier features [ 58 ] , with a transformer modulated by 𝐳 \mathbf{z} through adaLN-Zero [ 37 ] .
The loss is a squared error on positions, widths and thicknesses in world units, plus a cross-entropy on n n and a small KL term [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
卡片在控制点数量上有所不同,而发电机需要固定大小的标志.
一张卡 VAE 将卡片的控制点编码,相对于其根位置 p 1\ mathbf{p}_{1} , 变为潜在的 z → R 32\ mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{32} (图3,上).
它的编码器是一个在控制点之上的变压器,每个变压器都用它的弧长分数 u i ∈ [0, 1] u_{i}\in [0, 1] 来标记,加上一个学习到的汇总符号,其输出给出了 z\ mathb{z} 的平均值和日志变量.
解码器从 z\ mathbf{z} 中预测出 n n 控制点的数量, 并用 n 统一间隔的弧长分数来评价卡片, 内嵌有低频的 Fourier 特性 [58], 变压器由 z\ mathb{z} 通过 adaLN-Zero [37] 来调制.
该损失是世界单位位置,宽度和厚度的平方误差,外加nn上的交叉通取和小KL名词[19].

blocks.en:
Each card becomes a token 𝐱 = ( 𝐩 1 , 𝐝 1 , 𝐳 , s , e ) ∈ ℝ 40 \mathbf{x}=(\mathbf{p}_{1},\mathbf{d}_{1},\mathbf{z},s,e)\in\mathbb{R}^{40} (1) that holds its root position and root normal, its latent, its cross-section type s s ( − 1 -1 for rhombic, + 1 +1 for triangular) and an existence flag e = + 1 e=+1 .
A hairstyle is a set of N = 192 N=192 token slots, and an empty slot is all zeros except e = − 1 e=-1 .
After sampling, we read s s and e e by their sign.
blocks.zh:
每张卡会变成一个符号 x (p 1, d 1, z, s, e ) → R 40\ mathbf{ x} (\ mathbf{ p}_{ 1},\ mathb{ d}_{ 1},\ mathb{ s, e\ mathb{ R}^{40} (1) 保持根部位置和根部正常,其潜伏,截面类型 s (为rhombic − 1 - 1, + 1 + 1 + 1 为三角) 和存在旗 e = + 1 e=+ 1 .
发型为一组N=192 N=192个符位,除e=- 1 e=-1外,空位均为0.
在取样后,我们通过他们的标志读取s和e。

blocks.en: 3.2 Set diffusion of hair cards
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 设定发卡的传播

blocks.en:
The set DiT, a diffusion transformer [ 37 ] , denoises the N N token slots of a hairstyle together ( Fig. 3 , bottom).
It uses no positional embedding, so it is equivariant to permutations of the slots, and no order of the cards is ever defined.
Each block applies self-attention across the slots, cross-attention to the condition tokens 𝐂 \mathbf{C} and an MLP, all modulated by the timestep and the pooled condition through adaLN-Zero.
For a point cloud, 𝐂 \mathbf{C} is the output of a frozen Dora-VAE encoder [ 4 ] ; for an image, it comes from an image encoder ( Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
成套的DiT,一个扩散变压器[37],将发型相通的N符号槽(图3,下方)一起剥出.
它不使用位置嵌入法,因此它等同于插槽的相接法,也从未定义出卡的顺序.
每个区块在插槽之间应用自意,跨出条件符 C\ mathbf{C}和一个 MLP,均由时序和集合条件通过adalN-Zero来调节.
对于点云,C\mathbf{C}是被冷冻的多拉-VAE编码器的输出 [4];对于图像,它来自图像编码器(sec. 3.3).

blocks.en:
We train the generator with flow matching [ 25 , 27 ] .
For the token set 𝐗 0 \mathbf{X}_{0} of a training hairstyle and Gaussian noise ϵ \boldsymbol{\epsilon} , the network 𝐯 θ \mathbf{v}_{\theta} predicts the velocity along the straight path between them: 𝐗 t \displaystyle\mathbf{X}_{t} = ( 1 − t ) ​ 𝐗 0 + t ​ ϵ , \displaystyle=(1-t)\,\mathbf{X}_{0}+t\,\boldsymbol{\epsilon}, (2) ℒ \displaystyle\mathcal{L} = 𝔼 𝐗 0 , ϵ , t ​ ‖ 𝐯 θ ​ ( 𝐗 t , t , 𝐂 ) − ( ϵ − 𝐗 0 ) ‖ 𝐰 2 , \displaystyle=\mathbb{E}_{\mathbf{X}_{0},\boldsymbol{\epsilon},t}\,\big\|\mathbf{v}_{\theta}(\mathbf{X}_{t},t,\mathbf{C})-(\boldsymbol{\epsilon}-\mathbf{X}_{0})\big\|_{\mathbf{w}}^{2}, (3) where ∥ ⋅ ∥ 𝐰 \|{\cdot}\|_{\mathbf{w}} weights the root position and the existence flag by 4 and the other components by 1.
We drop the condition in training to allow classifier-free guidance [ 17 ] .
At test time we integrate with the Euler method and guidance and decode every slot with e > 0 e>0 .
The existence flags let the card count settle during denoising together with the shapes.

我们训练发电机的流量匹配 [25,27].

我们放弃了训练条件,允许无分级指导 [17].
在测试时,我们与Euler方法和指针结合,并用 e > 0 e>0解码出每个槽.

blocks.en: 3.3 Generation from a single image
blocks.zh: 3.3 从单一图像生成

blocks.en:
The image model is a set DiT of the same architecture, conditioned on the output tokens of a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 [ 47 ] applied to a square crop around the hair and the face.
For in-the-wild images, SAM 3 [ 3 ] provides the hair and face masks.
blocks.zh:
图像模型是同一种建筑的一组DiT,以被冻结的DINov3 VIT-L/16 [47] 被应用到头发和相貌周围的正方形作物上的输出符为条件.
对于一团一团的画面,SAM 3[3]提供发型和面罩.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Head frame. (a) The dataset frame scales every character to height 1, so heads differ in size and height; the right character’s ears count toward its height and lower its head. (b) In the head frame, all characters share the face width W W and face top O O .
blocks.zh: 图5:总框架。 (a) 数据集框架的尺度是每个字符到一高,因此头的大小和高不一;右字符的耳朵朝高而下。 (b) 在头框中,所有字符共享面宽W W和面高O .

blocks.en:
The size and position of a hairstyle follow its head, whereas the dataset frame scales every character to unit height.
We therefore predict the cards in a head frame anchored to the face ( Fig. 5 ).
Each character is mapped by 𝐩 ↦ k ​ 𝐩 + 𝐛 \mathbf{p}\mapsto k\,\mathbf{p}+\mathbf{b} , where k = W / w k=W/w scales its face width w w to the median face width W W of the training set and 𝐛 \mathbf{b} moves the top center of its face to a common point O O ; widths and thicknesses scale with k k .
On rendered test characters, we map the output back with each character’s own k k and 𝐛 \mathbf{b} , which places the hair on its real head.
blocks.zh:
发型的大小和位置跟随其头部,而数据集框则将每个字符缩放到单位高度.
因此,我们预测,卡片将固定在正面(图5)。
每个字符由 p \ k k + b \ mathbf{ p \ mathbsto k\,\ mathbf{ mathbf{ b} 绘制,其中 k = W / w k = W / W 缩放其面宽 w w / w 缩放其面宽度为培训集的中位宽 W 和 b \ mathb{ b} 将面部上部中心移动到一个 O O 共同点; 宽度和厚度与 k 一起缩放 。
在给出的测试字符上, 我们用每个字符的 k k 和 b\ mathbf{ b} 来映射输出, 将头发放入其真实的头部 。

blocks.en:
We render every training character from 8 views in Blender [ 2 ] , with random body poses, hair motion from spring-bone simulation, and cameras from the front to the back of the head; the target is always the rest-pose card set.
We widen the appearance of the renders with synthetic style augmentation, such as halftone, XDoG [ 67 ] line drawings, flat colors and painterly filters ( Appendix A ), and we mix in renders restyled into three drawing styles, gacha (mobile-game) art, thick paint and semi-realistic painting, by an image-editing model [ 68 ] .
blocks.zh:
我们从 Blender [2] 的8个视图中制作出每一个训练角色, 随机的姿势, 从弹簧-骨模拟的发动, 以及从前到后头的相机; 目标总是休息的卡片设定 。
我们用合成风格的增强来拓宽制作器的外观,例如:半色调、XDoG[67]行画、平面颜色和绘画过滤器(附录A),我们用一个图像编辑模型来将制作器重新组合成三种绘画风格,即:gacha(移动游戏)、厚颜料和半现实主义绘画[68]。

TRELLIS.2 and Hunyuan3D-2.1 take the hair region as input, and TRELLIS.2 outputs a flat plate facing the camera for both illustrations. Each card has its own color.

blocks.en: 3.4 Spring-bone chains
blocks.zh: 3.4 春骨链

blocks.en:
Cards alone are static, but the hair of game and avatar characters must move with them.
Artists achieve this with spring-bone chains, sequences of joints hung from the head whose simulated motion the cards follow, and rig them by hand for every hairstyle; we generate the chains so that the output can be animated directly.
blocks.zh:
单是卡片是静态的,但游戏的发型和外形人物必须随它们一起移动.
艺术家们用弹簧骨链、 模拟卡片所遵循的头部所悬挂的关节序列来达到这个目的, 并用手把它固定在每一个发型上; 我们生成链条,以便输出可以直接被动画所使用。

blocks.en: A chain becomes a 27-dimensional token of its path (8 points by arc length), joint count, stiffness and existence flag, and a hairstyle a set of up to 48 chains.
blocks.zh: 连锁会成为其路径的27维符号(以弧长为8分),关节计数,僵硬和存在旗,发型可达48个连锁.

blocks.en:
The chain DiT has the same block design as the set DiT and generates the chain tokens of a hairstyle in the head frame with flow matching, cross-attending to its card tokens ( Fig. 3 ).
It is trained on the ground-truth card tokens and, at test time, reads the generated ones; cards from a point cloud are first mapped into the head frame ( Appendix A ).
blocks.zh:
链式DiT有与设定的DiT相同的块设计,并生成头框中发型的链式符号并有流相匹配,交叉意向为它的卡式符号(图3).
它通过地面-真实卡符号培训,在测试时读取生成的卡;点云卡首先被映入头框(附录A.).

blocks.en:
After generation, a fixed geometric skinning binds the cards to the chains.
We place the joints uniformly along each generated path.
A card follows the chain closest to the lower 60% of its centerline if their mean distance is below 0.4 face widths, and otherwise moves rigidly with the head; each of its points follows the nearest segment of that chain, blended linearly with the neighboring segment within half a segment of each joint, with a weight that rises from 0 at the chain’s root to 1 over 0.05 face widths of arc length.
We tune these two thresholds against the artists’ skin weights in the training data.
We simulate the chains with the VRM spring-bone update of UniVRM [ 62 , 63 ] , using the predicted stiffness and the drag and gravity of most VRoid chains.
blocks.zh:
一代后被固定的几何外皮将卡片绑入了锁链.
我们把关节统一排列在每一个产生的路径上。
如果卡片的平均相距低于0.4个面宽,则卡片沿着最接近其中线下60%的链子走来,否则会用头部紧紧地走去;卡片的每个点都沿着最接近的链子段走去,在每关节的半个段内线性地与相邻的段相混合,其重量从链根的0升至弧长的一多出0.05个面宽.
在训练数据中,
我们用UniVRM[62,63]的VRM弹簧骨更新来模拟链条,使用大多数VRoid链条的预测硬度和拖曳和重力.

blocks.en: 3.5 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 3.5 执行细节

blocks.en:
The card VAE has four encoder and four decoder layers of width 256, the set DiT 12 layers of width 768 (181.3M parameters) and the chain DiT 8 layers of width 384 (30.5M).
We train the point-cloud model for 80K steps with batch size 64 and the image model for 100K steps with batch size 48, both with AdamW [ 29 ] at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ; the image model starts from the point-cloud model.
We sample with 50 Euler steps and a guidance scale of 2; Appendix A lists the remaining settings.
blocks.zh:
卡片VAE有4个编码器和4个解码器层,宽度为256,套装DiT12层宽度为768(181.3M参数),链式DiT8层宽度为384(30.5M).
我们为80K步训练出分批大小64分的点-云模型和为100K步训练出分批大小48分的图像模型,两者都由亚当W[29]以学习速度10−4 10^{-4};图像模型从分批大小的点-云模型开始.
我们抽取了50个欧拉步骤,指导尺度为2;附录A列出了其余的设置.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Hairstyles generated by HairDeck from in-the-wild images. Hair colors are taken from the images for display.
blocks.zh: 图7:由海尔德克从"入迷"图像所生成的发型. 从图像取出发色以显示.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en:
We use the dataset of CHARM [ 15 ] , built from VRoid characters [ 39 ] : we take 36,440 of its training hairstyles and test on its 100 test hairstyles, with the point clouds CHARM released.
For single images, we render the front views of the 76 test characters whose complete models are available, and we collect 40 in-the-wild images, anime illustrations sampled at random and stratified by hairstyle.
blocks.zh:
我们使用由VRoid字符[39]所建的CHARM [15]的数据集:我们取了36,440个训练发型,并测试了100个测试发型,点云CHARM被放出.
对于单一的图像,我们制作76个测试人物的正面视图,这些人物的完整模型是可用的,我们收集了40个被随机抽取并被发型分级分级的活化图像,动画插图.

blocks.en:
On point clouds we follow CHARM’s protocol: it compares the generated cards with its ground truth, rebuilt from its card templates, by Chamfer distance (CD), earth mover’s distance (EMD), Hausdorff distance (HD) and voxel IoU.
As the templates estimate card orientations, we also evaluate against the original artist meshes.
Our orientation metric matches every generated card to the artist card closest in CD and averages the angle between their width directions over 32 positions along the card.
Root precision and recall are the shares of generated and ground-truth cards whose root position lies within 2% of the character height of a root position in the other set.
For single images, we align every output to the ground truth ( Appendix D ) and report the aligned CD and IoU on surface samples.
The failure rate is the share of results that have fewer than 25% of the ground-truth cards (16 cards for in-the-wild images) or leave the scalp bare (hair covers less than 80% of the top or the back of the head); for the image-to-3D generators, whose output is one fused surface without cards, only the scalp criterion applies.
We time every method on one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU (48 GB) with batch size 1, from the input to the cards, before meshing.
blocks.zh:
在点云上, 我们遵循CHARM的协议: 将生成的卡片与地面真实性进行比较,
作为模板估算出卡片取向,我们也对照原作的艺术家meshes来评价.
我们的取向指标将每张生成的卡与CD中最接近的艺术家卡相匹配,并平均其宽度方向之间的角度超过卡上32个位置.
根精度和回想是生成和地真卡的股份,其根位位于另一集根位的字符高度的2%以内.
对于单一的图像,我们把每个输出都与地面真相(附录D)对齐,并在地表样本上报告一致的CD和IoU.
故障率是指地面真人卡不到25%(16张卡片为"入迷"图像)或将头皮脱光(毛被盖不到顶部或后部的80%)的结果比例;对于图像到3D的发电机,其输出为一台没有卡片的被引信的表面,只适用头皮标准.
我们用一个NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU(48 GB)的分批尺寸1,从输入到卡片的每个方法来计时,放出前.

blocks.en: 4.2 Generation from point clouds
blocks.zh: 4.2 从点云生成

blocks.en: Table 1 : Generation from point clouds on CHARM’s 100 test hairstyles, with its protocol; orientation on the original meshes (artist cards meshed from root normals: 7.5°); time per hairstyle. Means leave out 1 DeepMesh and 3 BPT outputs that fail to scan.
blocks.zh: 表1: CHARM100测试发型上从点出云的生成,附其协议;对原始发型的取向(从根常态中取出艺术卡:7.5°);每个发型的时间. 表示省去1个DeepMesh和3个BPT无法扫描的输出.

blocks.en:
Tables 1 and 4 compare HairDeck with CHARM and autoregressive mesh generators on CHARM’s test set.
HairDeck lowers CHARM’s CD from 0.0117 to 0.0066 and the orientation error from 40.0° to 16.8°, while taking 1.01 s instead of 33.7 s.
Retrieving the training hairstyle with the closest condition reaches a CD of 0.0119, so CHARM is about as accurate as recalling a training hairstyle.
The mesh generators output a few large shells (MeshAnything V2, BPT) or triangle fragments (DeepMesh).
blocks.zh:
表1和表4将HairDeck与CHARM和CHARM测试集的自回网格发电机进行比较.
HairDeck将CHARM的CD从0.0117降到了0.0066,方向误差从40.0°降到了16.8°,同时取出1.01 s而不是33.7 s.
取回条件最接近的训练发型达到0.0119的CD,因此CHARM大约和召回训练发型一样准确.
网格生成器输出出几颗大贝壳(MeshAnything V2, BPT)或三角碎片(DeepMesh).

blocks.en:
The card-level autoregressive model in Tab. 1 generates our card tokens one after another, with about as many parameters as our set DiT.
One token per card already lowers CHARM’s CD to 0.0078 and the orientation error to 16.6°.

blocks.en:
The Dora encoder computes the condition tokens of a point cloud at query points that farthest point sampling picks from it, so the tokens of two point clouds have no correspondence.
To interpolate between two conditions, we match the tokens of the second to those of the first by Hungarian matching on the positions of their query points and blend the matched tokens linearly ( Fig. 9 ).

多拉编码器计算出一个点云在最远点采样从中取取出点云时的条件符号,所以两个点云的符号没有对应.
为了在两个条件之间插入,我们将第二个条件的标志与第一个条件的标志相匹配,通过匈牙利人在其查询点的位置上匹配,并线性地混合匹配的标志(图9).

blocks.en: The chain DiT reads only card tokens, so it can also rig card hairstyles that an artist modeled without spring bones; its evaluation on the artists’ cards in Sec. 4.5 measures this use.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 限制和结论

blocks.en:
HairDeck learns from stylized VRoid hairstyles, so very short hair and the alpha-textured cards of realistic hair lie outside its training data.
It generates the geometry and UV coordinates of the cards but no textures.
Some VRoid characters model bows and hats with hair cards, so HairDeck generates them as cards when the input shows them; filtering such cards from the training data would avoid this.
The chain DiT follows the chain layouts common among VRoid characters and generates fewer chains for unusual ones, such as many chains radiating from the crown. Figure 23 shows failure cases.
blocks.zh:
HairDeck学习了分型的VRoid发型,因此非常短的发型和现实发型的alpha-texted卡片都位于其训练数据之外.
它生成了卡片的几何和紫外坐标,但没有纹理.
一些有发卡的VRoid人物模型弓和帽子,因此HairDeck在输入显示时会把它们作为出牌来生成;从训练数据中过滤出这种出牌可以避免这种情况.
链式DiT遵循了VRoid字符中常见的链式布局,为不寻常的链式产生较少的链式,例如从花冠上散射出的许多链式. 图23显示失败案例。

blocks.en:
HairDeck generates the stylized hair cards of a character and the spring-bone chains that animate them from a single image.
Treating a hairstyle as an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, with one token per card and all tokens generated together, makes generation more accurate and faster than autoregressive decoding, and the same recipe generates the chains.
Assets built from other artist-defined primitives, such as garments sewn from panels or drawings made of strokes, can be generated in the same way.
blocks.zh:
hairDeck生成一个角色的分型发卡和从一个单一的图像中将其活化的弹簧骨链.
将发型视为一套无序的艺术家定义的原始相片,每张相片有一枚相片和所有相片一起生成相片,使得相片的生成更准确更快于自发解码,同一种配方产生相片链.
由其他艺术家定义的原始人所建造的资产,如从相板缝成的服装或由中风所制成的图纸,可以同样的方式产生.

The crop is the square around the union of the hair and face masks, with an 8% margin on each side.

DINOv3 [ 47 ] runs at 448 pixels and returns one class token, four register tokens and 784 patch tokens; a layer norm, a linear projection to the model width and a learned positional embedding turn them into the condition.
For in-the-wild images, SAM 3 [ 3 ] segments with the prompts “person”, “anime character”, “hair” and “face”; the union of the four masks, cleaned with a morphological closing and hole filling, is the matte that cuts the character out onto a white background, and the hair and face masks give the crop.

blocks.en:
For the point-cloud model, whose cards are in the dataset frame, we map the generated cards into the head frame with the test character’s k k and 𝐛 \mathbf{b} and re-encode them with the card VAE before running the chain DiT.
Chains come from the VRM files of the training characters: 32,979 of the 36,440 training hairstyles have hair chains, and leaving out those with more than 48 chains or more than 192 cards leaves 32,599 hairstyles with 438,672 chains.
The chain DiT has 6 attention heads. It is trained for 80K steps with batch size 128, AdamW at learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} after a linear warmup over 1,000 steps, condition dropout 0.1 and an exponential moving average with decay 0.999; all loss weights are 1 except 4 for the existence flag, and the chain slots are randomly permuted for every training sample.
We tune the two skinning thresholds of Sec. 3.4 , the assignment distance and the ramp length, on 200 random training characters with chains.
For each character, its own chains with their own physics parameters drive 16 points per card under four head motions (a turn, a nod, a jump and a sideways sway), once with the artists’ skin weights, where each point takes the weights of the nearest vertex of the hair mesh, and once with our skinning.
We choose the thresholds that maximize the motion correlation of Tab. 4 : sweeping the assignment distance over 0.15, 0.25, 0.4 and 0.6 face widths and the ramp length over 0.01 to 0.3 face widths gives 0.4 and 0.05 (correlation 0.84), and the ramp length barely matters.
On the 58 test hairstyles with chains, our skinning reaches a motion correlation of 0.77 with the artists’ skin weights.
The simulation follows the reference spring-bone update of UniVRM [ 63 ] : at every frame, the tip of each bone keeps ( 1 − drag ) (1-\text{drag}) of its previous displacement, moves toward its rest direction, rotated by the parent, by stiffness times the time step and along gravity by gravity times the time step, and is then pulled back to the bone length.
We use no colliders and run at 60 fps.
Generated chains use their predicted stiffness, drag 0.4 and no gravity.
blocks.zh:
对于点-云模型,其卡片在数据集框中,我们用测试字符的k k和b\mathbf{b}将所生成的卡片映入头框,并在运行链式DiT之前用卡片VAE重新编码.
连锁出自训练角色的VRM档案:36,440个训练发型中的32,979个有发型,而把有48个以上连锁或192个以上卡片的留出后会留下有438,672个连锁发型的32,599个发型.
链式DiT有6个关注头. 它为分批大小为128的80K级阶梯所训练,学分为2×10−4 2\times 10×4}经过1000多级阶梯的线性暖和后,条件退位为0.1级,并随衰减为0.999的指数移动平均值;除存在旗外,所有减重为1分,每个训练样本的链槽会随机穿行.
我们调谐了3.4Sec的两个剥皮阈值,任务距离和坡道长度,在200个有链子的随机训练字符上.
对每个角色来说,它自己的带物理参数的链条在四个头运动(一转、点头、一跳和一转而走)下每张卡片驱动出16分,一次是艺术家的皮肤重量,其中每个点取出最接近的顶点毛网的重量,一次取出我们的皮肤。
我们选择了最大限度地扩大Tab. 4的运动相关性的阈值:将任务距离扫到0.15、0.25、0.4和0.6相容宽度,将坡道长度扫到0.01至0.3相相相容宽度,使0.4和0.05相容宽度相容(correction 0.84),坡道长度几乎不重要。
在58个有链子的发型测试中,我们的皮肤与艺术家的皮肤重量达到0.77的运动相关性。
模拟遵循UniVRM [63] 的参考弹簧骨更新:在每个帧上,每个骨头的尖端会保持(1~拖动) (1-\text{drag})它之前的位移,向它的休息方向移动,由母体旋转,由时间步骤的硬度乘以重力乘以时间步骤,然后被拉回骨头长度.
我们不使用相撞器 运行在60英尺。
生成的链子使用它们的预测硬度,拖动0.4而无重力.

blocks.en:
In Tab. 4 , lengths are in face widths W W , and each chain is represented by 8 points along its path.
CD is the Chamfer distance between the path points of the generated and the artists’ chains.
Recall and precision are the shares of artist and generated chains whose points lie, on average, within 0.1 W W of the path of a chain in the other set.
For motion, the artists’ cards are skinned to each set of chains as in Sec. 3.4 , the artists’ chains keep their own physics parameters, and each rig is simulated under four head motions of 2.5 s each: a turn (a yaw of 50° in 0.35 s, then held), a nod (a pitch of 25° down and back in 0.5 s), a jump (0.15 m up and down in 0.6 s) and a sideways sway (6 cm at 1.5 Hz for two cycles).
The displacement of each of 16 points per card is taken relative to the moving head, minus its displacement with the head at rest, so that sagging under gravity does not count.
Motion is the correlation over card points between the mean displacement of each point and that under the artists’ chains, averaged over the four motions, and Ampl. is the mean displacement.
Fit is the share of chain path points within 0.1 W W of the card meshes.

blocks.en:
Every card mesh carries UV coordinates: the first runs across the width, so the two faces of a card mirror each other and need no seam, and the second is the arc-length fraction, from the root (0) to the tip (1).
To export to VRM, we replace the hair of a character model, its hair bones and its hair spring-bone groups with the generated cards, one spring-bone group per generated chain, and use the geometric skinning of Sec. 3.4 as skin weights.
Results from in-the-wild images are exported the same way, on the body of a test character with the hair color taken from the image.
blocks.zh:
每张卡网携带UV坐标: 第一张横跨宽度,所以一张卡的两相相映射,不需要接缝,第二张是从根(0)到尖端的弧长分数(1).
为了输出到VRM,我们用所生成的卡片来取而代之的是人物模型的发型,发型的发型和发型的弹簧-骨组,每个被生成的链条有一个弹簧-骨组,并使用Sec.3.4的几何剥取来作为皮肤重量.
在测试字符的正体上,从图像中取出发色,其结果以同样的方式导出。

blocks.en:
Table 8 starts from a VAE that decodes the control points by index, as StrokeFusion [ 89 ] decodes the points of a stroke.
It takes the same inputs as our card VAE; its encoder sees the control points without their arc-length fractions, and its decoder adds 𝐳 \mathbf{z} to 128 learned slot embeddings and predicts in each slot a control point and whether the slot holds one, with a squared error on standardized features.
Decoding at arc-length fractions instead cuts the reconstruction error by a factor of 4.3, and adaLN modulation [ 37 ] and the world-unit loss of Sec. 3.1 , in place of a squared error on standardized features, together lower it by another 29%.
The raw token resamples a card to 64 points by arc length and holds their positions relative to the root position, widths and thicknesses (317 values) with the number of control points; the PCA token holds the first 64 principal components of these 317 values, fitted on 300,000 training cards and scaled to unit variance.
blocks.zh:
表8从一个按索引解码控制点的VAE开始,因为StrokeFusion[89]解码了中风的点.
它需要与我们的卡VAE相同的输入;它的编码器看到没有弧长分数的控制点,它的解码器将z\mathbf{z}添加到128个已学习到的插槽中并预言在每个插槽中嵌入一个控制点,以及该插槽是否持有一个,在标准化特性上出现平方错误.
以弧长分数来解码重建出错的因子为4.3;取而代之的是adaLN调制 [37] 和世界单位损失的Sec. 3.1,取而代之的是标准化特性的平方误差,加起来又降低了29%.
生代号将一卡按弧长重新标出64分,并保持与根位置,宽度和厚度相比的位置(317个值)并有控制点数;PCA代号持有这317个值的前64个主要组件,被安装在30万个训练卡上并缩放到单位相差.

blocks.en:
Our cards keep the control point positions of CHARM’s templates; they differ in the width direction and in the widths and thicknesses, which we measure along the Bishop frame [ 1 ] . Table 9 rebuilds the artist cards with each choice of control points, root direction and propagation, and measures both the width direction and the shape.
CHARM’s templates take the root direction from the first three control points and solve the rest of the card by least squares, which keeps each width direction perpendicular to the card and close to its neighbors.
On the control points quantized into CHARM’s tokens (512 levels per position axis), least squares rebuilds the shape more closely than a Bishop frame from the same start, as CHARM found for Bishop propagation from estimated normals [ 15 ] , but both leave the width direction far off (40.6° and 35.3°), because the quantization turns the root direction from the first three points by 23.6° (median).
Without the quantization, the Bishop frame is closer in both direction and shape, and with the root direction of the original mesh it is closer still, on artist and quantized points alike (7.5° and 8.2°, against 19.3° and 19.6° for least squares): given the right root direction, the quantization costs less than 1°.
Our cards take this route, with the root normal of the original mesh propagated by a Bishop frame; the card VAE adds 0.8°, and keeping the root direction constant along the card gives 11.9°.
Our data cards are also closer to the original card meshes, with a two-sided point-to-surface distance of 0.945 × 10 − 3 0.945\times 10^{-3} against 1.388 × 10 − 3 1.388\times 10^{-3} for CHARM’s templates.

CHARM的模板从前三个控制点取出根取向并用最小的正方形来解析卡片的其余部分,使每个宽度取向都与卡片垂直并靠近其邻居.

blocks.en:
The procedural rig of Tab. 4 places chains on cards by rules, with parameters from the spring bones of 300 training characters and lengths in face widths W W .
Cards whose centerlines lie close (mean distance below 0.2 W W ) and point the same way form a unit, which gets one chain per 0.23 W W of its width.
A chain follows the mean centerline of its cards, fitted by a quadratic Bézier curve, and starts 15% of the card length from the root.
Longer chains get more joints and a lower stiffness, as in the training characters; all chains use drag 0.4 and no gravity.
blocks.zh:
塔布的程序平台 4按规则将链条放入卡片上,由300个训练角色和长度从弹簧骨中取出参数为面宽WW.
其中心线相近(平均距离低于0.2 W W. W. )并指向同一种方式形成一个单元的卡片,其宽度每0.23 W. W.
一条链沿其卡片的正中线行走,由四边形的贝塞尔曲线相接,并从根开始15%的卡片长度.
更长的链会得到更多的关节和更低的硬度,如在训练字符中;所有链会使用拖动0.4而无重力.

We run the official checkpoints of DiffLocks [ 42 ] .
Its pipeline crops the image around a face box, which we take from our face mask on every input.
Each output holds about 95K strands, which we convert into K = 60 K=60 cards: every strand is resampled to 16 points by arc length, k-means groups the strands into K K clusters, and each cluster becomes one card whose centerline is the mean of its strands and whose width, thickness and width direction come from the spread of the strands around it.
Strands laid inside the ground-truth cards and converted back reach an aligned CD of 0.0050, and K = 40 K=40 , 100 and 150 give 0.0172, 0.0174 and 0.0172, against 0.0174 for K = 60 K=60 .
